name: Injected private food-draft workspace controller and presentation boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
objective: Translate an injected FOOD-001D service into bounded framework-neutral private-workspace results without runtime activation, transport parsing or UI construction.
unchangedAuthorities: Reuse FOOD-001A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H unchanged: A domain semantics, B/C immutable persistence and retry/concurrency semantics, D authorization/service, E/F/G runtime composition/acquisition/server adapter, H activation runbook.

input.construction: Synchronous and I/O-free; invoke no service operation during construction.
input.operationInputs: Mutation operations accept already-typed FOOD-001A domain inputs, explicit versions and expected predecessors. No string/JSON body/FormData/checkbox/select/HTTP parsing.
input.authorization: Forward mutation inputs directly to FOOD-001D without controller-side domain validation first. Preserve authorization-before-validation; unauthorized callers must not learn whether submitted data or IDs are valid.

controllerOperations: Exact product detail with automatic exact referenced recipe retrieval
presentationModels: Latest-list results preserve exact service snapshots, deterministic service order and unchanged continuation cursors.
Exact recipe detail distinguishes found and not-found explicitly; never invent whole-product completeness for recipe-only detail.
Recipe/product histories preserve immutable snapshots in service/repository order and unchanged continuation cursors.
Mutation feedback distinguishes created, already-present and conflict; conflict is a successful mutation outcome, not a service failure.
Failed lists remain failures, never successful empty lists.
Return only bounded outcome/feedback state. Do not retain, echo or serialize submitted payloads in failure results; later HTTP/UI form-state retention is separate.
Do not mutate returned snapshots or historical arrays. New presentation objects must be detached/frozen where appropriate so callers cannot mutate domain history indirectly.
productDetailAggregate: Read the exact product through FOOD-001D. If not-found, return product not-found with zero recipe lookup.
If found, perform a separately authorized FOOD-001D exact recipe read using exactly the recorded recipe ID/version. Never substitute latest or bypass authorization for the second read.
If the referenced exact recipe is not retrievable or the second service call fails, fail closed for aggregate detail; do not expose misleading partial complete detail.
For successful product plus exact recipe aggregation, call assessFoodDraftEvidenceCompleteness unchanged.

requirements: Display structural presence separately from unknown, pending, undisclosed or inconclusive conditions; true requiredEvidencePresent may coexist with unresolved reviews.
Never translate completeness into approved, safe, cottage eligible, tax exempt, sellable, launch ready or ready to sell.
Empty reviewed allergen declarations never create allergen-free wording or claims.
Preserve unfavorable and inconclusive reviewed findings without approval interpretation.

domainFieldPresentation: Preserve ingredients and one explicit level of purchased-component subingredients; disclosed versus undisclosed composition remains distinct.
Preserve declared allergens and existing detail/source fields, allergen review lifecycle, process/preservation classification and temperature classification.
Preserve cottage and tax review lifecycle separately from conclusions.
Preserve exact evidence subject type/ID/version, source/reference, review date and reviewer/issuer attribution.
Preserve optional historical label reference exactly; no label generation.
Preserve omitted fields versus explicit unknown states. Introduce no display names, pricing, quantities, yield, marketing text or new domain fields.
Human-readable recipe/product names require a separate FOOD-001A-compatible domain decision.
revisionAndRetry: Revision operations are explicit appends with intended version, expected predecessor, exact recipe ID/version references and immutable historical versions.
Never mutate prior versions, silently renumber, merge revisions, retarget evidence, substitute latest recipe or retry using a newly generated version.
Changing the referenced recipe version remains a new product revision.
Introduce no persisted idempotency system. Preserve B/C identical canonical identity/version/content retry as already-present and differing same-key content as conflict.
Never automatically retry after uncertainty. Later HTTP integration must preserve submitted identity/version/content when reconciling an uncertain result.
Expose no delete, overwrite, destructive repair or sale-activation operations.

failurePresentation.codePreservation: Preserve the underlying FOOD-001D failure code and use fixed private-workspace feedback, never raw service or exception text.

messages.access-unavailable: Food draft access could not be checked.
messages.invalid-input: The food draft submission is invalid.
messages.storage: Food draft storage is unavailable. Reconcile the result before retrying.

failurePresentation.conflictMessage: A different version already exists. Refresh and reconcile before retrying.
failurePresentation.sanitization: Expose no SQL/D1 messages, exception text, stack traces, private evidence values through errors or internal repository conflict reasons. Already-present remains distinct from conflict.

tests: All ten controller operation families forward exact arguments, versions, recipe references, expected predecessors, optional arguments and limits/cursors.
Latest-list cursor/order preservation; failures do not become empty successes.
Exact recipe found/not-found and exact product found/not-found.
Product detail retrieves the exact historical recipe automatically, skips recipe lookup on product not-found and never substitutes latest.
Second-read access/storage failures and missing exact recipe fail closed for aggregate detail without partial private snapshots.
Histories preserve ascending immutable versions; created/already-present/conflict remain distinct.
All five failure codes retain fixed sanitized feedback without submitted payload retention or internal conflict reasons.
Authorization-first preservation, including invalid typed inputs passed at runtime and denied callers learning no validity information.
requiredEvidencePresent remains independent from unresolved conditions; cover unfavorable/inconclusive reviewed findings, explicit unknown states and undisclosed purchased components.
Empty reviewed allergen declarations confer no allergen-free claim; historical label references are preserved exactly.
Immutable/frozen/detached presentation state cannot alter domain history or service-returned arrays.
Identical retry versus conflicting retry, no automatic retry or version generation, no destructive operations and no readiness/sale-authority projection.
Source isolation from Astro/HTTP/FormData/routes/runtime acquisition/D1 configuration/migrations/commerce/payment/deployment/unrelated systems.
excludedAndDeferredScope: Astro routes/pages/actions, HTTP/string/JSON body/FormData parsing, cookies, redirects, response or HTML rendering.
CSRF/same-origin and POST enforcement belong to later HTTP integration; repository retry semantics do not replace these protections.
Astro components, navigation changes and safe form-value retention.
Runtime acquisition/activation, RIVER_FOOD_DB provisioning/configuration, migration execution and administrator secret configuration.
Public food product pages, commerce/checkout/Stripe, fulfillment/accounting/community counters.
Deployment, production data and unrelated insurance/Sesh/creator changes.
validationForCurrentTask: git diff --check and new-file whitespace check
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification. Do not implement, modify existing files, stage, commit, configure runtime access, migrate, access D1 or deploy.
nextStep: Review this specification before separately authorizing the two-file framework-neutral workspace controller implementation.
